factual_limits: The breakfast table is a generalized planning scene, not a documentary photograph of a named Lanzhou hotel, cafe, tour office, or transport lounge.
The three blank cards represent mutually exclusive planning branches and contain no route, operator, price, time, booking, or opening information.
Food, furniture, bags, notebook, devices, window view, and exact staging are illustrative and cannot identify a business or current service.
The figure does not establish that any nearby branch is open or bookable on the travel date.
reader_caption_policy: Describe the four guides comparing three complete return branches at breakfast; do not mention generation or imply that the blank cards contain live route information.
rights: Original LazyTravel composition; external character and location imagery was used only as an unredistributed visual reference
